description: This PHP class defines a report filter field for Employee Number within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterField class and implements ValueXNormalizable, providing methods to add filtering conditions to a query, retrieve entity aliases, and convert internal values to an array representation with employee details.

classes.name: EmployeeNumber
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering employees by their employee number in report queries within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query to filter by employee number if the operator is EQUAL and the value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in the query, which is 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the employee number value to an array with employee details if the employee exists; otherwise, returns null.
